item.title: Hawley, Banks, Tuberville File Amendment to Protect State Laws Banning Men in Women’s Sports
item.dc:creator: Madeline Sieren
item.description:
WASHINGTON — Today, U.S. Senators Josh Hawley (R-Mo.), Jim Banks (R-In.) and Tommy Tuberville (R-Ala.) filed an amendment to the Protect College Sports Act to ensure the bill does not overturn any state laws banning men from women’s sports. item.title: Hawley Bill Banning Bonuses for Postmaster General Passes Committee
item.dc:creator: Anna Thompson
item.description:
WASHINGTON —  Today, U.S. Senator Josh Hawley (R-Mo.)’s No Bonuses for Bad Service Act passed out of the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee in an overwhelming bipartisan vote. This legislation would prohibit United States Postal Service (USPS) leadership from receiving bonuses or additional compensation until mail service and delivery meet the standards that the American people deserve.
